title: euphorbia ebracteolata f. coreana
intro: Euphorbia ebracteolata f. coreana, commonly known as Korean spurge, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Korean spurge include its ability to stimulate collagen synthesis, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in Korean spurge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
